Alex: Quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Priya: Did kernel microbatch perf run this morning. p95 down ~15% after switching slot allocator tweak. Numbers attached below.
Marco: Nice — can you drop the benchmark output?
Priya: sure, paste from the runner:
```
runs: 3\nconfig: microbatch=32, slot_alloc=packed\nlatency_ms: [62, 58, 61]\np95: 61 -> 52 (approx)\nthroughput_tps: 180\n```
Jen: Nice improvement. Any regression on tail (p99)?
Priya: p99 is noisy: 210ms -> 190ms, still investigating a sporadic GC on the sidecar.
Alex: Blockers?
Priya: Sidecar GC spikes when cache eviction pressure hits. Need to tune KV cache watermark and maybe bump the eviction sampler to skip hot prefixes.
Marco: I can throw a hotfix to the eviction sampler today. Will open a PR shortly. @Priya can you add a short repro script?
Priya: Yep, will add a small load script to reproduce the eviction spike (will post link).
ops-bot: deploy-canary: rollout started for kernel/batching v0.4.2 to canary pool (3 nodes) :rocket:
Alex: PR ping: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/812 (eviction-sampler-fix). @Marco please add unit tests around sampler heuristics.
Marco: will do. Plan for today: land sampler fix, run full perf sweep against canary, validate p95/p99.
Jen: I'll follow up on consoles — adding a per-route eviction metric so SRE can alert before sidecar GC (small dashboard change).
Alex: Other quick asks?
Priya: One more — need a short call for the KV config defaults before I flip the canary flag. 15 min?
Marco: I'm free 14:30 PT.
Jen: 14:30 works for me.
Alex: OK scheduled 14:30 PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
